The other key adds a new line.
Favori olmayan, çalışan uygulamalardan b: This many running, non-favorite apps are shown directly in the list; the rest are collapsed.
Hemen: metin gösterilmeden gönderilir; d: Right away: the text is sent without being shown; there's no chance to stop it.
Metin panele geldikten sonra bekleme sür: Once the text appears in the panel, it's sent to the default target when the wait is over. Pressing a key or clicking stops it.
Panelde %@ metni varsayılan hedefe gönde: In the panel, %@ sends the text to the default target and ⌘1…⌘9 to the other apps in the list. The text is put on the clipboard and pasted into the app with ⌘V; if delivery fails, the text stays on the clipboard.
Panelde gösterilecek diğer uygulama sayı: Other apps shown in the panel
Sürükleyerek sırala. En üstteki varsayıl: Drag to reorder. The top one is the default target (%@); the ones below are sent with ⌘1, ⌘2… in order. Apps that aren't running are opened.
